main_measure.name: mean of (forecast/10) x excess 2-bar return from the 11:00 bar's close, pooled over coins
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and slope > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 300 cases

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess 2-bar return on forecast

decided_by: The main measure has a mean above 0 with t >= 2 and the slope is above 0.
reading: The 2-bar return runs from the close of the bar stamped 11:00 to the close of the bar stamped 13:00 of the same window (cases without that bar are dropped), the coin's mean 2-bar return is taken on the non-overlapping grid 0, 2, 4, ... of each window pooled over all windows, and fewer than 300 cases is reported as not observable.
